reverify.proposable_mechanism: Depletion-refractory decoding: at each step, when locally accumulated evidence exceeds a threshold, hard-commit a token AND subtract a diffusing 'depletion' field from the probabilities of semantically/positionally nearby tokens; that field decays (refills) over subsequent steps, so the next near-duplicate commitment can only occur after a geometrically-spaced gap -> periodic diversity in the output stream.

The distinctive Liesegang extras -- geometric spacing, outward propagation, refill-gated refractory timing -- are over-specifications of the source physics with NO demonstrated decoding benefit beyond existing diversity controls. Same pattern as Run-25 C94 drift-metric dressing and Run-24 C41 held-dwell: a literal gap at exact-mechanism resolution, but the surviving-absent details are arbitrary source-borrowed embellishments, not a motivated distinct LLM advantage. novelty~0.55, mechanism~0.6, verifiability~0.6, non_trivial~0.4 -> composite 0.45. overall.verdict: CONFIRM-SUB-GATE. C37 (Suppletion) and C57 (Liesegang rings) BOTH stand as TRUE sub-Gate-1 leads after a third fully-independent pass: each genuinely SURVIVES the literal exact-mechanism collision test (10 fresh real WebSearches total returned only the linguistic/physics SOURCE or mechanism-distinct ML work -- no functional collision), so they are NOT false positives to be explained away (R14 respected). C37's specificity-with-default-blocking is a paraphrase adjacent to maximal-munch/longest-match + defeasible priority, with 'blocking' lifted from its own source; C57's stated diversity payoff is already met by repetition penalties + DPP, with geometric-spacing/refill-refractory being source-borrowed dressing. C30 correctly stands as a COLLISION (Setting the Trap honeypot, confirmed real). All 4 key collision citations (C30, C94, C65, C88) are REAL and functionally match; ZERO suspect/hallucinated citations. Net: 2 survivors confirmed as genuine sub-gate gaps, 0 leads clear Gate 1, 0 hallucinations.
